services.name: Art Classes
services.desc: Adults and teens of all skill levels are invited to explore their creativity through inspiring visual arts classes led by studio artist, muralist, and book illustrator Peggy Grinvalsky. Known for her relaxed teaching style, Peggy helps students learn to draw what they see, develop a lively sense of color, and experiment with bold vitality. Tuesday mornings 10 am - Noon $225. services.name: Private Music Lessons
services.desc: The Campanile Conservatory of the Arts is a welcoming place for students of all ages and skill levels-children and adults, beginners and accomplished artists alike. Whether you're just starting your artistic journey or seeking advanced instruction, you’ll find a professional and caring faculty dedicated to helping you achieve your goals. Our instructors specialize in guiding young beginners through foundational skills and supporting advanced students in refining their talents. At the heart of the Conservatory is our commitment to fostering personal growth, confidence, and well-being through the transformative power of artistic achievement. This season offers a vibrant mix of music, tributes, community showcases, and returning favorites - all chosen to inspire, entertain, and bring us together.
